description: Detect and remove silent pauses from audio or video files. Preserves video & audio lip-sync in 'start_end' mode. Returns original duration and seconds saved.

inputPath.description: Path to the source audio or video file.

minDurationSeconds.description: Minimum silence duration in seconds to trigger a cut. Default: 0.5.

mode.description: Trim mode: 'start_end' removes silence at the start and end (preserving perfect A/V sync on videos); 'all_pauses' removes silent pauses across audio files. Default: 'start_end'.

outputPath.description: Destination path for the trimmed file (e.g. './recordings/cleaned.mp4').

thresholdDb.description: Volume threshold in decibels, between -60dB and -10dB. Audio quieter than this is treated as silence. Default: -35.

name: trim_silence
